This 2015 Chevrolet Tahoe LTZ in Black represents a capable SUV built for those who value both performance and comfort. With comprehensive features designed for towing, entertainment, and daily driving, this vehicle delivers the space and capability that come with the Tahoe name.

- Cocoa/Mahogany perforated leather-appointed seat trim
- Chevrolet MyLink radio with navigation and SiriusXM compatibility
- Power sunroof
- Rear seat DVD entertainment system with Blu-Ray capability
- Bose Centerpoint Premium 10-speaker surround sound system
- Max Trailering Package with integrated trailer brake controller
- 3.42 rear axle ratio
- 2-Speed active electronic transfer case with locking differential
- 20-inch chrome wheels
- Heated power-folding mirrors with auto-dimming capability
- Heated leather-wrapped steering wheel
- Wireless charging pad
- Three-zone automatic temperature control with front and rear A/C
- Forward collision alert and lane departure warning with safety alert seat
- Rear cross-traffic alert with side blind zone monitoring

The EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission achieves 16 mpg in city driving and 22 mpg on the highway. The four-wheel drive system provides traction across various road conditions, while the magnetic ride control suspension package delivers responsive handling whether you're navigating highways or rougher terrain.

Safety and convenience merge seamlessly throughout this Tahoe. The vehicle includes dual-zone front air conditioning with rear air conditioning for passenger comfort, along with power-adjustable pedals and a power tilt and telescoping steering column. Multiple 12-volt auxiliary power outlets and a universal home remote add practical functionality. Forward collision alert and lane departure warning with safety alert seat work in conjunction with rear cross-traffic alert and side blind zone alert to help keep you aware of your surroundings.

Entertainment options ensure that all passengers enjoy the drive. The rear seat DVD entertainment system with Blu-Ray capability keeps rear-seat occupants engaged, while the Bose premium sound system delivers quality audio throughout the cabin. The MyLink system with navigation provides guidance and connectivity.

Functionality extends to the cargo area with the hands-free power liftgate, allowing convenient access even when your hands are full. The third row seats feature 60/40 power-fold capability, creating flexible interior space for cargo or passengers as needed. Split-folding rear seats add further versatility for your lifestyle.

We invite you to visit our showroom to see this Tahoe in person and discover how its combination of capability, comfort, and technology can serve your driving needs.

This 2015 Ford Explorer XLT represents a well-maintained three-row SUV designed to meet the needs of families seeking versatility, capability, and reliable performance.

- Power Liftgate
- Voice-Activated Navigation System
- SYNC w/MyFord Touch and 8" touchscreen
- Rearview Camera with Rear Parking Sensors
- Dual Zone Electronic Automatic Temperature Control
- Premium Audio System with 9 Speakers and SiriusXM
- BLIS Plus with Blind Spot Information and Cross Traffic Alert

- Remote Start System

The Explorer XLT arrives equipped with genuine capability through its 3.5L 6-cylinder engine paired with a 6-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive. This combination delivers practical performance for both highway driving and varied road conditions. The vehicle achieves 17 mpg in the city and 23 mpg on the highway, balancing power with reasonable fuel efficiency for a three-row SUV platform.

Interior comfort extends across three rows with split-folding rear seating that adapts to your cargo and passenger needs. The front bucket seats feature leather trim and heating functionality, while the power-adjustable driver seat ensures personalized comfort during extended drives. Climate management is handled through dual-zone automatic temperature control, allowing front and rear passengers to set individual preferences.

Technology integration centers on the SYNC system with MyFord Touch interface, featuring an 8-inch color touchscreen, voice-activated controls, and navigation capability. The premium audio package delivers nine speakers throughout the cabin, enhanced by SiriusXM satellite radio with a six-month prepaid subscription. Two configurable 4.2-inch color LCD displays in the instrument cluster provide driver-selected information, while connectivity includes dual USB ports and SD card functionality.

Safety features reflect Ford's comprehensive approach to occupant protection. The vehicle includes dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags. Blind Spot Information System with Cross Traffic Alert helps prevent accidents during lane changes and parking maneuvers. Inflatable rear seatbelts in outboard positions provide additional safety for second-row passengers. The rearview camera and rear parking sensors assist with backing operations, while electronic stability control and traction control work continuously to maintain vehicle stability.

The brown exterior with polished 20-inch aluminum wheels and body-color bumpers presents a clean, maintained appearance. Practical exterior features include heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators, roof rails for cargo carrying, fully automatic headlights with delay-off capability, and front fog lights for improved visibility in various conditions.

You can come and experience this vehicle here at Ferguson Subaru in Broken Arrow, Ok!

This 2015 Mazda CX-5 Grand Touring delivers versatile crossover capability combined with thoughtful design and reliable performance for today's driver.

- 2.5L SKYACTIV®-G 4-Cylinder Engine with 6-Speed Automatic Transmission
- All-Wheel Drive
- Power Moonroof
- Heated Front Sport Shape Seats with Leather Trim
- Bose Premium Audio System with 9 Speakers
- Rear Parking Camera
- Automatic Temperature Control with Front Dual Zone A/C
- Fully Automatic Headlights with Fog Lights
- Power Driver Seat with Lumbar Support
- Heated Door Mirrors with Power Adjustment
- Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls
- Split Folding Rear Seat for Cargo Flexibility
- Remote Keyless Entry
- 19-Inch Aluminum Alloy Wheels

The engineering behind this crossover reflects Mazda's commitment to creating vehicles that balance efficiency and capability. Achieving 24 mpg city and 30 mpg highway, the SKYACTIV®-G engine provides responsive power while helping manage fuel costs. All-wheel drive adds confidence in various driving conditions, whether navigating city streets or weekend excursions.

Inside, the cabin prioritizes comfort and convenience. Heated front seats keep you warm during colder months, while the automatic dual-zone climate control allows both driver and passenger to set preferred temperatures independently. The power moonroof floods the interior with natural light and fresh air. The leather-trimmed interior reflects the Grand Touring's elevated appointments, while heated door mirrors and automatic headlights demonstrate attention to practical details that enhance daily driving.

The Bose audio system with nine speakers delivers quality sound for your commute or road trips. Steering wheel controls keep your attention on the road, while the trip computer provides useful driving information. The rear parking camera adds helpful visibility when backing into tight spaces, and rain-sensing wipers automatically adjust to weather conditions.

Safety features include four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system. The four-wheel independent suspension contributes to responsive handling, while speed-sensing steering adjusts to driving conditions.

Standard all-weather floor mats protect the interior from the elements. The split-folding rear seat expands cargo capacity when needed, making this CX-5 suitable for everything from daily errands to larger loads.

This Grand Touring represents solid crossover value with proven Mazda reliability. We invite you to schedule a test drive and discover how this vehicle meets your driving needs.

Practical storage solutions round out the package. The split-folding rear seat expands your cargo area for larger items, while the cargo convenience package includes a net and cover for organized transport. The rear backup camera helps with parking and maneuvering in tight spaces.

This Equinox offers the combination of reliability, efficiency, and comfort that makes it a practical choice for drivers who value straightforward functionality and value.

The white exterior of this Rogue presents a clean, professional appearance that works well in any setting. Inside, you'll find leather-appointed front bucket seats with heating functionality, providing comfort during both short trips and longer drives. The automatic temperature control maintains your preferred climate with separate front dual zones, while rear window defrost ensures clear visibility in all conditions.

Safety is integrated throughout this vehicle with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and anti-whiplash front head restraints. The four-wheel independent suspension paired with electronic stability control and traction control delivers confident handling on various road surfaces. Brake assist and four-wheel disc ABS brakes provide reliable stopping power when you need it.

The cabin offers convenient technology features including a nine-speaker audio system with AM/FM/CD capability, remote keyless entry, and illuminated entry for easy access. Climate control functions include air conditioning with rear window defroster. The power driver seat allows you to find your ideal driving position easily.

Practical storage solutions include a front center armrest with storage, driver and passenger door bins, illuminated kick plates, and both driver and passenger vanity mirrors. Splash guards protect the vehicle's lower body from road debris, while the roof rack with rails provides flexible cargo carrying options. The retractable cargo cover keeps items in the back secure and organized.

On the road, this Rogue achieves 26 MPG in the city and 33 MPG on the highway, delivering balanced efficiency for everyday driving. The 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with CVT transmission provides smooth, responsive acceleration. Speed-sensing steering and fog lights enhance visibility and control during various driving conditions.

We invite you to schedule a time to see this 2015 Nissan Rogue SL and discover how its blend of safety, comfort, and practicality can meet your transportation needs. Contact us today to arrange a test drive.

description:
This 2015 Ford Edge SEL delivers the practicality and performance you need in a mid-size crossover that's ready for work and weekend getaways alike.

- Premium 9 Speaker Audio
- SYNC w/MyFord Touch infotainment system
- 8" LCD touch-screen with media hub and dual USB ports
- Leather-trimmed heated bucket seats
- Class II Trailer Tow Package with Trailer Sway Control
- Black roof rack side rails
- 18" aluminum sparkle silver painted wheels
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Power driver seat with lumbar support
- SiriusXM satellite radio
- Rear parking sensors and exterior parking camera
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- Fully automatic headlights with delay-off feature

The EcoBoost 2.0L turbocharged engine balances efficiency with capability, delivering 20 city and 30 highway MPG. The six-speed automatic transmission handles both daily commutes and highway driving with confidence. All-wheel drive isn't required here—the front-wheel-drive setup keeps maintenance straightforward while providing the space and comfort you expect from the Edge platform.

Inside, you'll find practical features designed around how you actually live. The SYNC system with MyFord Touch puts navigation, phone integration, and audio controls at your fingertips through the eight-inch touchscreen. Heated leather seats warm you on cold mornings, and the dual-zone climate control lets you and your passenger set your own temperatures. The split-folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs, whether you're hauling groceries or gear.

Safety is a priority throughout the Edge. You get four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system including front, side, and overhead protection. The rear parking sensors and backup camera help you navigate tight spaces with confidence.

The Class II trailer tow package makes this Edge capable of handling small trailers, giving you extra versatility whether you're moving equipment or heading out with a boat. Roof rack side rails add convenient mounting options for additional gear.

This white exterior with its clean lines presents professional appeal on any road. The 18-inch wheels and black roof rails add visual interest while remaining practical. At this price point, you're looking at a well-equipped crossover with modern conveniences that won't demand premium fuel or constant visits to the gas station.

The 2015 Edge SEL represents solid value in the crossover segment—equipped to handle real-world needs without unnecessary frills.

This 2015 INFINITI QX60 Base in stunning pearl white offers a refined driving experience with genuine three-row capability and thoughtful luxury appointments for families who value both comfort and practicality.

- Pearl white special paint with color-matched splash guards
- Premium Package with heated steering wheel and remote engine start
- Premium Plus Package featuring INFINITI Navigation System and Around View Monitor with front and rear sonar
- BOSE 13-speaker premium audio system with Bluetooth streaming
- Leather-appointed heated front seats with dual occupant memory system
- Third-row seating with split folding rear seats for flexible cargo configurations
- Cargo Package including tonneau cover and underfloor storage dividers
- 3.5L V6 engine with sport-tuned CVT transmission delivering efficient power
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning
- Bi-Xenon HID headlights with front fog lights and rain-sensing wipers
- Power moonroof and roof rail cross bars
- 18-inch 5-spoke aluminum alloy wheels
- Electronic Stability Control and comprehensive airbag system

The QX60 provides a commanding view of the road with its elevated seating position and excellent visibility enhanced by the Around View Monitor system. The three-row layout accommodates up to seven passengers, making it an ideal choice for larger families or those who frequently transport groups. The split folding rear seats expand your versatility, easily transitioning between passenger comfort and cargo hauling when needed.

Inside, you'll find a well-appointed cabin featuring leather steering wheel and shift knob, heated front seats, and an intuitive layout that places controls within easy reach. The Premium Plus Package includes the INFINITI Navigation System with its 8-inch touchscreen display, providing clear lane guidance and 3-D building graphics for confident navigation. The INFINITI Voice Recognition system allows hands-free control of audio, navigation, and vehicle information.

The performance characteristics strike a practical balance with the 3.5L V6 engine delivering 21 city and 27 highway MPG ratings. The sport-tuned CVT transmission provides smooth acceleration while supporting efficiency. Electronic Stability Control and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain composure through various driving conditions, while the comprehensive safety system includes dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags for passenger protection.

This QX60 combines genuine utility with genuine refinement—a vehicle built for families who refuse to compromise on either. The combination of three-row seating, premium audio and navigation, intelligent storage solutions, and well-executed comfort features makes this a practical choice that you'll enjoy every time you drive. Contact us today to schedule your test drive and experience what this capable crossover has to offer.

Heated front seats and the power-adjustable driver seat with lumbar support enhance your comfort on extended drives.

Practical features make this SUV functional for families and active lifestyles. The power liftgate simplifies cargo loading, while the split-bench third-row seats provide flexibility for passengers or additional storage space. Roof rack rails accommodate carriers for extra capacity. Rear air conditioning and rear audio controls keep all passengers comfortable on trips.

Exterior details include body-color bumpers, heated power mirrors with turn signal indicators, and a rear window wiper for improved visibility. The auto-dimming interior and exterior mirrors reduce glare during varying light conditions. These thoughtful touches contribute to a refined ownership experience.

This Traverse represents a solid choice for those seeking room, comfort, and reliability in a family SUV. We invite you to visit our showroom to evaluate this vehicle in person and discuss how it meets your transportation needs.

This 2015 Ford Explorer Limited represents a well-maintained three-row SUV that delivers practical family transportation with a host of convenient features and a clean ownership history.

- Clean Carfax
- Apple CarPlay ready
- Dual-panel moonroof
- Third-row seating
- Leather-trimmed heated bucket seats
- Sony premium audio system with 12 speakers
- Power driver and passenger seats with memory
- Rear parking sensors and backup camera
- Automatic temperature control with front and rear zones
- SiriusXM satellite radio
- Heated rear seats
- Remote keyless entry with HomeLink garage door transmitter
- SYNC with MyFord Touch
- 20-inch painted aluminum wheels
- Four-wheel disc brakes with electronic stability control

The Explorer Limited accommodates up to eight passengers with its flexible seating configuration. The front seats offer heating and power adjustment with memory settings, making it easy to customize comfort preferences. The second row features a center armrest, while the third row folds flat to expand cargo space when needed. Recent maintenance records show this vehicle has been cared for consistently.

Under the hood, this SUV is powered by a 3.5L V6 engine paired with a six-speed automatic transmission. Front-wheel drive makes maneuvering straightforward, while the independent suspension system provides balanced handling. You can expect approximately 17 miles per gallon in the city and 24 miles per gallon on the highway. The four-wheel disc brake system with ABS and electronic stability control contributes to responsive, predictable stopping performance.

The cabin features a Sony audio system with 12 speakers and SiriusXM satellite radio capability. Dual-zone automatic climate control maintains separate temperatures for driver and front passenger, while rear air conditioning keeps everyone comfortable. Speed-sensitive wipers and fully automatic headlights operate intelligently to match driving conditions. The moonroof floods the interior with natural light and fresh air appeal.

Safety components include dual front airbags, front and rear side-impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic stability control and traction control work together to help maintain grip and directional control. Rear parking sensors combined with a backup camera assist during reversing maneuvers, while low tire pressure monitoring keeps you informed about tire condition.

The gray exterior presents a neutral aesthetic that suits diverse preferences. Body-colored bumpers, fog lights, and heated power mirrors complement the 20-inch painted aluminum wheels. The roof rack provides mounting options for additional cargo, and the rear wiper keeps the back glass clear during inclement weather.

Cleveland Ford offers an exclusive Nationwide Lifetime Powertrain Warranty on select inventory. This warranty covers everything that the manufacturer considers part of the powertrain, and can be used with any ASE Certified Mechanic across the country and even in Canada. Ask your salesperson if your vehicle qualifies.

The split folding rear seat provides flexible cargo configuration, and practical amenities include illuminated entry, front reading lights, an overhead console with trip computer, and an outside temperature display. Driver and passenger vanity mirrors along with door storage bins add everyday functionality.

Safety is prioritized with a comprehensive airbag system including dual front impact, front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags. Four-wheel independent suspension, front and rear anti-roll bars, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to maintain control and confidence on various road surfaces.

description: ATHLETIC, ELECTRIC, ONE-OWNER, NONSMOKER, READY FOR THE FUTURE! The Hyundai IONIQ 5 completely reimagined what an electric crossover could be, combining futuristic styling, an exceptionally spacious interior, rapid charging capability, and impressive real-world efficiency into one of the most celebrated EVs of the modern era. This 2022 Hyundai IONIQ 5 SE RWD delivers the smooth, quiet driving experience electric vehicles are known for while offering the practicality and versatility of a compact SUV. Powered exclusively by electricity, this rear-wheel-drive IONIQ 5 produces 225 horsepower and delivers instant torque for smooth, effortless acceleration. Its dedicated Electric-Global Modular Platform provides outstanding interior space, a remarkably flat cabin floor, and balanced handling that make every drive comfortable whether you're commuting, running errands, or heading out on a road trip. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The IONIQ 5 has earned widespread acclaim because it doesn't feel like a compromise. Instead of simply replacing a gasoline engine with batteries, Hyundai engineered the vehicle from the ground up as an EV, resulting in outstanding passenger room, excellent ride quality, fast charging capability, and a modern design that stands apart from nearly everything else on the road. Buyers also appreciate the IONIQ 5's blend of practicality and innovation. Its hatchback design offers generous cargo space, the spacious cabin feels more like a midsize SUV than a compact crossover, and its quiet electric powertrain delivers an exceptionally refined driving experience with virtually no maintenance compared to a traditional gasoline-powered vehicle. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION The Hyundai IONIQ 5 has been one of the most decorated electric vehicles introduced in recent years. Automotive journalists have praised its bold styling, outstanding interior packaging, rapid charging capability, comfortable ride, and overall value, making it one of the benchmark EVs in its class. 2022 World Car of the Year. 2022 World Electric Vehicle of the Year. 2022 World Car Design of the Year. Named to numerous Car and Driver and MotorTrend Editors' Choice lists. WARRANTY The odometer is hovering around the 108,733-mile mark. While the original New Vehicle Limited Warranty has expired based on the current mileage, Hyundai's Electric Vehicle Battery Warranty may still provide remaining coverage on the original high-voltage battery system, subject to Hyundai's warranty terms and transferability provisions. Please contact us if you would like assistance reviewing the remaining factory EV battery coverage for this vehicle. Extended vehicle service plans may also be available to help provide additional peace of mind for many major mechanical and electrical components beyond the remaining factory coverage. STANDARD FEATURES The SE trim offers an impressive collection of equipment, combining advanced electric vehicle technology with Hyundai's thoughtful design philosophy. From its spacious interior and sophisticated driver-assistance systems to its outstanding efficiency and fast-charging capability, the IONIQ 5 was engineered to make everyday electric driving both practical and enjoyable. INSTALLED OPTIONS This IONIQ 5 was ordered with the following factory option: Standalone Features Atlas White exterior paint. CHARGING, RANGE & ELECTRIFIED POWERTRAIN The rear-wheel-drive IONIQ 5 SE is powered by a 168-kW permanent-magnet electric motor producing 225 horsepower and 258 lb-ft of torque, paired with a 77.4-kWh high-voltage battery pack. Its EPA-estimated driving range when new was 303 miles on a full charge, making it one of the longest-range electric crossovers available in its class. Charging flexibility includes: Level 1 (120-Volt): Approximately 2 to 3 miles of range per hour using a standard household outlet. Level 2 (240-Volt): Approximately 7 hours for a full charge using a properly equipped home or public Level 2 charger. DC Fast Charging: Thanks to its advanced 800-volt electrical architecture, battery charging from approximately 10% to 80% can take as little as 18 minutes when connected to a compatible 350-kW DC fast charger. MECHANICAL FEATURES Built on Hyundai's dedicated Electric-Global Modular Platform (E-GMP), the IONIQ 5 delivers a driving experience unlike that of a conventional gasoline-powered crossover. With its battery mounted beneath the floor, the vehicle benefits from a low center of gravity that enhances stability, improves handling, and contributes to a remarkably smooth, composed ride. Unlike traditional vehicles that require oil changes, spark plugs, timing belts, or complex multi-speed transmissions, the IONIQ 5's electric powertrain has significantly fewer moving parts, reducing routine maintenance while providing instant, seamless acceleration every time you press the accelerator. Additional mechanical highlights include: 225-horsepower rear-mounted permanent magnet electric motor. Single-speed reduction gear transmission. Rear-wheel drive. 77.4-kWh high-voltage lithium-ion battery. Multi-link rear suspension. Regenerative braking system with adjustable settings. Steering-wheel-mounted regenerative braking paddles. i-Pedal one-pedal driving capability. Drive Mode Select. Electric power steering. Four-wheel disc brakes. Battery thermal management system. EXTERIOR FEATURES The IONIQ 5's unmistakable design blends futuristic styling with retro-inspired details to create one of the most distinctive vehicles on today's roads. Crisp body lines, pixel-inspired lighting, and clean proportions give it an appearance that looks just as modern today as when it first debuted. Exterior equipment includes: Atlas White exterior paint. LED projector headlights. LED Daytime Running Lights. LED taillights with Parametric Pixel lighting signature. Automatic headlights. Heated power exterior mirrors. Flush power door handles. Rear spoiler. Rear window wiper. 19-inch alloy wheels. Acoustic laminated windshield. Privacy glass. INTERIOR FEATURES Inside, the IONIQ 5 offers a surprisingly open and airy cabin thanks to its dedicated EV platform. The flat floor design creates outstanding passenger comfort while providing generous legroom and flexible storage solutions throughout the interior. Interior amenities include: Cloth seating surfaces. Heated front seats. Power-adjustable driver's seat with lumbar support. Automatic climate control. Leather-wrapped steering wheel. Push-button start. Proximity Key with push-button start. Sliding center console. Split-folding rear seatbacks. Multiple USB charging ports. Ample front and rear storage compartments. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY Hyundai equipped the IONIQ 5 with an advanced digital cockpit that blends intuitive controls with modern connectivity. Large high-resolution displays and seamless smartphone integration make it easy to stay informed, entertained, and connected throughout every journey. Technology features include: Dual 12.3-inch digital displays. Integrated digital instrument cluster. 12.3-inch touchscreen infotainment system. Wireless Apple CarPlay compatibility.* Wireless Android Auto compatibility.* Bluetooth hands-free calling and audio streaming. SiriusXM capability. Activation or paid subscriptions may be required. HD Radio. Hyundai Bluelink connected services. Activation or paid subscriptions may be required. Dynamic Voice Recognition. Over-the-air software update capability for supported systems. Multiple USB charging ports. *For the 2022 model year, Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are supported via a wired USB connection rather than wirelessly. SAFETY FEATURES Hyundai equipped the IONIQ 5 with an extensive suite of advanced safety technologies designed to help monitor surrounding traffic, assist the driver during everyday travel, and provide additional confidence on long highway trips. Hyundai SmartSense driver-assistance technologies work together to help make every journey safer and more relaxing. Safety features include: Forward Collision-Avoidance Assist with Pedestrian Detection. Lane Keeping Assist. Lane Following Assist. Blind-Spot Collision-Avoidance Assist. Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist. Driver Attention Warning. Safe Exit Assist. High Beam Assist. Smart Cruise Control with Stop & Go. Rear Occupant Alert. Rearview camera with dynamic guidelines. Electronic Stability Control. Vehicle Stability Management. Traction Control System. Hillstart Assist Control. Tire Pressure Monitoring System. Advanced airbag system. ... and there's SO MUCH more! If available, vehicle files can be found above this description on our website, including the original brochure and window sticker! With its ONE-OWNER history, spacious cabin, exceptional charging capability, long EPA-estimated driving range, and innovative design, it continues to set the benchmark for what a modern electric crossover can be. The future of driving arrived years ago ... and it's still turning heads. - Bose Personal Plus Audio System with amplifier and 8 speakers including driver headrest
- Heated Front Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel

This Kicks SR delivers strong fuel economy with an EPA rating of 31 city and 36 highway miles per gallon, making it an economical option for your commute and weekend errands. The 1.6L 4-cylinder engine with CVT transmission provides smooth acceleration and responsive performance, while front-wheel drive ensures confident handling in varied driving conditions.

Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your focus on the road, while the sport steering wheel and telescoping column accommodate your preferred driving position. The split-folding rear seat provides flexibility for cargo or passenger configurations.

The red exterior finish is complemented by 17" black alloy wheels and splash guards, creating a distinctive appearance. Heated door mirrors and automatic wipers round out the practical features that make daily driving more convenient.

This well-equipped 2023 Nissan Kicks SR represents solid value for a buyer prioritizing reliability, fuel efficiency, and everyday comfort. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand and discuss how it meets your transportation needs.

This Santa Fe Sport delivers the utility and features expected from a midsize crossover, backed by a straightforward mechanical foundation and an abundance of convenience technologies designed to enhance your daily driving experience.

The combination of capability, technology, and comfort makes this Grand Cherokee a well-rounded choice for buyers seeking a midsize SUV that performs in multiple environments.

This 2014 Grand Cherokee Summit represents a vehicle built to meet the demands of discerning drivers who value both capability and refinement. We invite you to examine it firsthand and discover how well it aligns with your driving needs.

***SOLD AS IS BECAUSE OF MILES & HAS HAIL CURRENTLY ON IT***

- Heated seats and heated steering wheel for cold-weather comfort

- Uconnect 8.4" touchscreen with GPS navigation
- SiriusXM satellite radio with traffic updates
- Bi-Xenon HID headlamps with auto high beam control
- LED daytime running headlamps

- Remote start system

- Power tilt/telescope steering column

The 5.7L V8 engine with multi-displacement technology and 8-speed automatic transmission delivers balanced performance while the 4WD system provides confidence in various driving conditions. Inside, the cabin reflects the Limited trim's emphasis on comfort, with heated front and rear seating, automatic climate control with front and rear zones, and power-adjustable front seats that include memory settings for personalized positioning.

The Uconnect infotainment system features an 8.4-inch touchscreen with integrated voice command and Bluetooth connectivity, making it easy to stay connected while keeping your focus on the road. GPS navigation capability combined with SiriusXM Travel Link integration helps you navigate efficiently, while HD Radio technology expands your audio options beyond traditional broadcasting.

Practical features enhance daily usability, including the power liftgate for convenient cargo access, rear parking camera for awareness when reversing, and exterior parking sensors. The rain-sensitive windshield wipers adjust automatically to weather conditions, and the auto-dimming rearview mirror reduces glare during evening drives.

Safety systems throughout include electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and a comprehensive airbag array including front, side, and overhead protection. The four-wheel disc braking system with ABS and brake assist rounds out the safety-focused design.

This Grand Cherokee Limited provides a well-equipped package that balances capability, comfort, and technology for drivers seeking a versatile SUV. We encourage you to schedule a visit to see this vehicle and experience its blend of features firsthand.
